The Rust port passes all 6 example cases in `node check.mjs` and 3 unit tests (`cargo test`). On a generated 50 MB input it runs in about 0.15 s.

- **Code:** `src/main.rs` reads all of stdin and lowercases it in place. It splits on any byte that isn't an ASCII letter and counts the words in a `HashMap` without copying each one. It then picks the top 10, ordered by count descending and then by word in byte order. It uses only the standard library and edition 2024.
- **Build:** `build.sh` r
